question: Which techniques does software S0002 (Mimikatz) use?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: Software S0002 (Mimikatz) uses 17 ATT&CK techniques, including Security Account Manager (T1003.002), DCSync (T1003.006), Pass the Hash (T1550.002), and Golden Ticket (T1558.001). These techniques involve various methods for credential theft, authentication manipulation, and lateral movement.
